00-governance-core.title: Governance Core
00-governance-core.goal: Own the operating model, canonical source rules, package topology, naming, dictionaries, boundaries, change budgets, freeze protocols, review rules, and the tactical subsystem used by every run.
deliverables: review model and tactical execution subsystem
produces: constitutional rules all package chats must obey

01-identity-access-and-trust.title: Identity, Access, and Trust
01-identity-access-and-trust.goal: Define identity, authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, isolation rules, secrets boundaries, and security acceptance gates for the project.
produces: identity and access contracts consumed by service, experience, platform, and quality packages

02-domain-data-and-persistence.title: Domain, Data, and Persistence
02-domain-data-and-persistence.goal: Own the domain model, data ownership rules, persistence strategy, event and history semantics, migration and backfill strategy, and data quality contracts.
produces: domain and data contracts consumed by service, platform, and quality packages

03-service-contracts-and-orchestration.title: Service Contracts and Orchestration
03-service-contracts-and-orchestration.goal: Own service boundaries, API and event contracts, orchestration flows, error models, integration surfaces, and service wiring decisions.
deliverables: API, event, or task contract map
produces: service contracts consumed by experience, platform, and quality packages

04-experience-clients-and-interactions.title: Experience, Clients, and Interactions
04-experience-clients-and-interactions.goal: Own user-facing experiences, client architecture, journeys, interaction contracts, routing and navigation, client-state policy, and accessibility/performance rules.
deliverables: loading, empty, and error state rules
produces: client-facing contracts and interaction-ready implementation plans

05-platform-infrastructure-and-delivery.title: Platform, Infrastructure, and Delivery
05-platform-infrastructure-and-delivery.goal: Own environment topology, runtime and infrastructure boundaries, configuration and secrets mapping, delivery workflows, observability, rollback, and operational platform runbooks.
produces: delivery and platform contracts consumed by quality and operations

06-quality-release-and-operations.title: Quality, Release, and Operations
06-quality-release-and-operations.goal: Own the verification strategy, release criteria, operational readiness, regression control, smoke checks, and post-release validation model across the whole project.
consumes: all upstream contracts and acceptance gates
produces: execution proof, release readiness, and operational validation evidence
